</section>

  <script>
    /* ============================================================
       I. THE ENGINE
       Pure simulation. No DOM, no canvas, no clocks. A seeded engine
       can be advanced synchronously, which is how the same succession
       can be studied headless and faster than the eye.
       ============================================================ */
    (() => {
      'use strict';

      const WORLD = Object.freeze({ width: 168, height: 104 });
      const CELLS = WORLD.width * WORLD.height;
      const CYCLES_PER_GENERATION = 180;
      const GENE_KEYS = Object.freeze(['speed', 'vision', 'metabolism', 'repro']);
      const GENE_INFO = Object.freeze({
        speed: { min: 0.6, max: 2.4, label: 'speed', unit: 'cells / cycle' },
        vision: { min: 3, max: 20, label: 'vision', unit: 'cells' },
        metabolism: { min: 0.5, max: 1.8, label: 'metabolism', unit: 'turnover' },
        repro: { min: 42, max: 132, label: 'reproduction threshold', unit: 'energy' }
      });

      const SPECIES = Object.freeze({
        prey: {
          key: 'prey', name: 'glasswing moth', plural: 'glasswings',
          cap: 700, minAge: 26, baseCost: 0.048, digestTime: 9,
          geneBase: { speed: 1.12, vision: 8.5, metabolism: 0.95, repro: 82 },
          geneJitter: { speed: 0.3, vision: 2.5, metabolism: 0.25, repro: 10 },
          maxAgeBase: 430, maxAgeSpan: 170
        },
        predator: {
          key: 'predator', name: 'ember spider', plural: 'ember spiders',
          cap: 160, minAge: 42, baseCost: 0.088, digestTime: 13,
          geneBase: { speed: 1.56, vision: 12.2, metabolism: 1.16, repro: 112 },
          geneJitter: { speed: 0.34, vision: 3.2, metabolism: 0.25, repro: 13 },
          maxAgeBase: 650, maxAgeSpan: 270
        }
      });

      const CATASTROPHE_META = Object.freeze({
        drought: {
          key: 'drought', order: 'I', label: 'Drought', note: 'desiccation',
          title: 'The glass dries.',
          copy: 'Regrowth arrests. The standing moss thins to a pale memory while the chamber waits for water.',
          color: '#c7a56e', colorSoft: 'rgba(199,165,110,.5)', glyph: 'D'
        },
        plague: {
          key: 'plague', order: 'II', label: 'Plague', note: 'pale blight',
          title: 'A pale blight.',
          copy: 'Infection moves through the glasswings. The ember spiders inherit its hunger, not its mercy.',
          color: '#b18c9b', colorSoft: 'rgba(177,140,155,.5)', glyph: 'P'
        },
        frost: {
          key: 'frost', order: 'III', label: 'Frost', note: 'cold chamber',
          title: 'The chamber cools.',
          copy: 'Every body slows; every body burns a little faster to stay alive. The moss draws down into itself.',
          color: '#9db7be', colorSoft: 'rgba(157,183,190,.5)', glyph: 'F'
        }
      });

      const DEFAULTS = Object.freeze({
        seed: 1897,
        mutation: 6,
        regrowth: 1.10,
        horizon: 36,
        tempo: 4,
        events: Object.freeze({
          drought: Object.freeze({ enabled: true, interval: 12 }),
          plague: Object.freeze({ enabled: true, interval: 17 }),
          frost: Object.freeze({ enabled: true, interval: 9 })
        })
      });

      const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
      const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
      const normalizeSeed = (value) => {
        const n = Number.parseInt(String(value).replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10);
        return Number.isFinite(n) ? ((n % 1000000) + 1000000) % 1000000 : 0;
      };
      const formatSeed = (value) => String(normalizeSeed(value)).padStart(6, '0');
      const deriveSeed = (value) => {
        const n = normalizeSeed(value);
        let x = (n ^ 0x9e3779b9) >>> 0;
        x = Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 16), 0x21f0aaad) >>> 0;
        x = Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 15), 0x735a2d97) >>> 0;
        x = (x ^ (x >>> 15)) >>> 0;
        return x % 1000000;
      };

      // xmur3 string hash, used once to seed the inexpensive mulberry32 stream.
      function xmur3(str) {
        let h = 1779033703 ^ str.length;
        for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
          h = Math.imul(h ^ str.charCodeAt(i), 3432918353);
          h = (h << 13) | (h >>> 19);
        }
        return () => {
          h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 2246822507);
          h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 3266489909);
          h ^= h >>> 16;
          return h >>> 0;
        };
      }

      class SeededRandom {
        constructor(seed) {
          this.state = seed >>> 0;
        }
        next() {
          let t = this.state += 0x6D2B79F5;
          t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
          t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        }
        int(max) { return Math.floor(this.next() * max); }
        range(lo, hi) { return lo + this.next() * (hi - lo); }
        chance(probability) { return this.next() < probability; }
        // A bounded, symmetric distribution with most mass near zero.
        bell() { return (this.next() + this.next() + this.next() + this.next() - 2) / 2; }
        pick(list) { return list[this.int(list.length)]; }
      }

      const makeSimRandom = (seed) => new SeededRandom(xmur3(`nocturne/sim/${formatSeed(seed)}`)());
      const makeViewRandom = (seed) => new SeededRandom(xmur3(`nocturne/view/${formatSeed(seed)}`)());

      class VivariumEngine {
        constructor(options = {}) {
          this.hooks = options.hooks || {};
          this.seed = normalizeSeed(options.seed ?? DEFAULTS.seed);
          this.settings = {
            mutation: clamp(Number(options.mutation ?? DEFAULTS.mutation), 0, 30),
            regrowth: clamp(Number(options.regrowth ?? DEFAULTS.regrowth), 0.2, 2.4),
            horizon: clamp(Math.round(options.horizon ?? DEFAULTS.horizon), 4, 160)
          };
          this.eventSettings = {};
          for (const key of Object.keys(CATASTROPHE_META)) {
            const source = options.events?.[key] || DEFAULTS.events[key];
            this.eventSettings[key] = {
              enabled: source.enabled !== false,
              interval: clamp(Math.round(source.interval ?? DEFAULTS.events[key].interval), 3, 30)
            };
          }
          this.reset();
        }

        reset() {
          this.rng = makeSimRandom(this.seed);
          this.tick = 0;
          this.generation = 0;
          this.finished = false;
          this.eventSerial = 0;
          this.catastrophes = [];
          this.activeConditions = new Map();
          this.history = [];
          this.births = { prey: 0, predator: 0 };
          this.deaths = { prey: 0, predator: 0 };
          this.mutations = 0;
          this.generationBirths = { prey: 0, predator: 0 };
          this.generationDeaths = { prey: 0, predator: 0 };
          this.peak = { prey: 0, predator: 0 };
          this.extinctions = {};
          this.initializePlants();
          this.initializeCreatures();
          this.initializeCalendar();
          this.recordGeneration();
        }

        initializeCalendar() {
          this.calendar = {};
          for (const key of Object.keys(CATASTROPHE_META)) {
            const settings = this.eventSettings[key];
            this.calendar[key] = {
              enabled: settings.enabled,
              interval: settings.interval,
              nextAt: settings.enabled ? settings.interval : Infinity,
              lastAt: null
            };
          }
        }

        initializePlants() {
          const plants = new Float32Array(CELLS);
          const width = WORLD.width;
          const height = WORLD.height;

          // A scatter of dormant spores.
          for (let i = 0; i < CELLS; i++) {
            if (this.rng.chance(0.075)) plants[i] = this.rng.range(0.18, 0.8);
          }

          // Broad, irregular colonies give the dish its first composition.
          const colonies = 20;
          for (let c = 0; c < colonies; c++) {
            const cx = this.rng.range(10, width - 10);
            const cy = this.rng.range(8, height - 8);
            const rx = this.rng.range(9, 30);
            const ry = this.rng.range(6, 21);
            const richness = this.rng.range(0.45, 0.95);
            const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cx - rx));
            const x1 = Math.min(width - 1, Math.ceil(cx + rx));
            const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(cy - ry));
            const y1 = Math.min(height - 1, Math.ceil(cy + ry));
            for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) {
              for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
                const dx = (x - cx) / rx;
                const dy = (y - cy) / ry;
                const d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                if (d > 1) continue;
                const chance = (1 - d) * richness;
                if (this.rng.chance(chance)) {
                  const idx = y * width + x;
                  plants[idx] = Math.max(plants[idx], this.rng.range(0.45, 1));
                }
              }
            }
          }
          this.plants = plants;
        }

        makeGenes(species, inherited = null) {
          const info = SPECIES[species];
          const genes = {};
          for (const key of GENE_KEYS) {
            if (inherited) {
              const span = GENE_INFO[key].max - GENE_INFO[key].min;
              const rate = this.settings.mutation / 100;
              const mutation = this.rng.bell() * rate * span * 1.35;
              genes[key] = clamp(inherited[key] + mutation, GENE_INFO[key].min, GENE_INFO[key].max);
            } else {
              const jitter = this.rng.bell() * info.geneJitter[key];
              genes[key] = clamp(info.geneBase[key] + jitter, GENE_INFO[key].min, GENE_INFO[key].max);
            }
          }
          return genes;
        }

        makeCreature(species, x, y, genes, energy, age = 0) {
          const meta = SPECIES[species];
          const maxAge = meta.maxAgeBase + this.rng.int(meta.maxAgeSpan);
          const heading = this.rng.range(0, Math.PI * 2);
          return {
            species, x, y, genes,
            energy,
            age,
            maxAge,
            heading,
            moveCredit: this.rng.next(),
            digest: 0,
            alive: true,
            origin: age === 0 ? 'seed' : 'immigrant'
          };
        }

        randomEdgeSafePoint() {
          return {
            x: this.rng.int(WORLD.width - 8) + 4,
            y: this.rng.int(WORLD.height - 8) + 4
          };
        }

        initializeCreatures() {
          this.prey = [];
          this.predators = [];
          const preyCount = 128;
          const predatorCount = 16;
          for (let i = 0; i < preyCount; i++) {
            const genes = this.makeGenes('prey');
            const p = this.randomEdgeSafePoint();
            const energy = genes.repro * this.rng.range(0.5, 0.78);
            const age = this.rng.int(SPECIES.prey.maxAgeBase * 0.52);
            this.prey.push(this.makeCreature('prey', p.x, p.y, genes, energy, age));
          }
          for (let i = 0; i < predatorCount; i++) {
            const genes = this.makeGenes('predator');
            const p = this.randomEdgeSafePoint();
            const energy = genes.repro * this.rng.range(0.58, 0.88);
            const age = this.rng.int(SPECIES.predator.maxAgeBase * 0.42);
            this.predators.push(this.makeCreature('predator', p.x, p.y, genes, energy, age));
          }
          this.peak.prey = this.prey.length;
          this.peak.predator = this.predators.length;
        }

        get activeList() { return [...this.activeConditions.values()]; }

        isActive(key) {
          return this.activeConditions.has(key);
        }

        growthModifier() {
          let modifier = 1;
          if (this.isActive('drought')) modifier *= 0.25;
          if (this.isActive('frost')) modifier *= 0.78;
          return modifier;
        }

        movementModifier() {
          return this.isActive('frost') ? 0.56 : 1;
        }

        metabolicMultiplier() {
          return this.isActive('frost') ? 1.3 : 1;
        }

        step() {
          if (this.finished) return false;
          this.tick += 1;
          this.expireConditions();

          if (this.isActive('plague')) this.applyPlague();

          this.growPlants();
          this.updatePrey();
          this.updatePredators();
          this.updateMetabolismAndAge();

          this.reproduce('prey');
          this.reproduce('predator');
          this.compactDead();

          if (this.tick % CYCLES_PER_GENERATION === 0) {
            this.generation = Math.floor(this.tick / CYCLES_PER_GENERATION);
            this.fireDueEvents();
            this.recordGeneration();
            if (this.generation >= this.settings.horizon) {
              this.finished = true;
              this.hooks.onFinish?.(this.history[this.history.length - 1]);
            }
            this.hooks.onGeneration?.(this.history[this.history.length - 1]);
          }
          return true;
        }

        runToEnd(limit = 2000000) {
          let guard = limit;
          while (!this.finished && guard-- > 0) this.step();
          return this.finished;
        }

        expireConditions() {
          if (!this.activeConditions.size) return;
          for (const [key, condition] of this.activeConditions) {
            if (this.tick >= condition.endTick) {
              this.activeConditions.delete(key);
              this.hooks.onConditionEnd?.({ ...condition, key });
            }
          }
        }

        growPlants() {
          const growth = 0.00215 * this.settings.regrowth * this.growthModifier();
          const plants = this.plants;
          // Existing biomass thickens. Empty glass receives a small spore fall.
          for (let i = 0; i < CELLS; i++) {
            const value = plants[i];
            if (value > 0 && value < 1) {
              plants[i] = Math.min(1, value + growth * (0.35 + (1 - value) * 0.75));
            }
          }
          const attempts = Math.floor(CELLS * 0.00072 * this.settings.regrowth * this.growthModifier());
          for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
            const idx = this.rng.int(CELLS);
            if (plants[idx] < 0.035) plants[idx] = this.rng.range(0.035, 0.15);
          }
        }

        senseNearest(map, x, y, radius, predicate = null) {
          const rays = 16;
          const maxRadius = Math.max(0, Math.floor(radius));
          for (let r = 1; r <= maxRadius; r++) {
            for (let ray = 0; ray < rays; ray++) {
              const angle = ray * (Math.PI * 2 / rays);
              const nx = Math.round(x + Math.cos(angle) * r);
              const ny = Math.round(y + Math.sin(angle) * r);
              if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= WORLD.width || ny >= WORLD.height) continue;
              const value = map[ny * WORLD.width + nx];
              if (value && (!predicate || predicate(value))) {
                return { x: nx, y: ny, dx: nx - x, dy: ny - y, distance: r, value };
              }
            }
          }
          return null;
        }

        createMap(list) {
          const map = new Int32Array(CELLS);
          map.fill(-1);
          for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            const a = list[i];
            if (a.alive) map[a.y * WORLD.width + a.x] = i;
          }
          return map;
        }

        plantMap() {
          const map = new Uint8Array(CELLS);
          for (let i = 0; i < CELLS; i++) map[i] = this.plants[i] > 0.2 ? 1 : 0;
          return map;
        }

        headingStep(agent, desiredAngle, wildness = 0.36) {
          let bestX = agent.x;
          let bestY = agent.y;
          let bestScore = -Infinity;
          for (let octant = 0; octant < 8; octant++) {
            const angle = octant * Math.PI / 4;
            const nx = agent.x + Math.round(Math.cos(angle));
            const ny = agent.y + Math.round(Math.sin(angle));
            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx >= WORLD.width - 1 || ny >= WORLD.height - 1) continue;
            let score = Math.cos(angle - desiredAngle);
            score += (this.rng.next() - 0.5) * wildness;
            const edgeX = Math.min(nx, WORLD.width - 1 - nx) / 10;
            const edgeY = Math.min(ny, WORLD.height - 1 - ny) / 10;
            score += Math.min(0.22, edgeX * 0.06 + edgeY * 0.06);
            if (agent.lastX === nx && agent.lastY === ny) score -= 0.035;
            if (score > bestScore) {
              bestScore = score;
              bestX = nx;
              bestY = ny;
            }
          }
          if (bestX === agent.x && bestY === agent.y) {
            const fallback = this.rng.int(8);
            bestX = clamp(agent.x + Math.round(Math.cos(fallback * Math.PI / 4)), 1, WORLD.width - 2);
            bestY = clamp(agent.y + Math.round(Math.sin(fallback * Math.PI / 4)), 1, WORLD.height - 2);
          }
          agent.lastX = agent.x;
          agent.lastY = agent.y;
          agent.x = bestX;
          agent.y = bestY;
          agent.heading = Math.atan2(bestY - agent.lastY, bestX - agent.lastX);
        }

        stepsFor(agent, speedScale = 1) {
          agent.moveCredit += agent.genes.speed * speedScale;
          let steps = Math.min(3, Math.floor(agent.moveCredit));
          agent.moveCredit -= steps;
          return steps;
        }

        eatPlant(agent) {
          if (agent.digest > 0) return false;
          const idx = agent.y * WORLD.width + agent.x;
          const biomass = this.plants[idx];
          if (biomass < 0.22) return false;
          const bite = Math.min(0.42, biomass);
          this.plants[idx] = Math.max(0, biomass - bite);
          const gain = (2.8 + agent.genes.metabolism * 2.8) * (0.6 + bite * 1.25);
          agent.energy = Math.min(agent.energy + gain, agent.genes.repro * 1.65 + 20);
          agent.digest = SPECIES.prey.digestTime;
          this.hooks.onEffect?.('graze', agent.x, agent.y, { strength: bite });
          return true;
        }

        updatePrey() {
          const predatorMap = this.createMap(this.predators);
          const plantMap = this.plantMap();
          const speedScale = this.movementModifier();
          const visionScale = 1;
          const count = this.prey.length;
          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const a = this.prey[i];
            if (!a.alive) continue;
            const threat = this.senseNearest(predatorMap, a.x, a.y, Math.max(3, a.genes.vision * visionScale));
            let food = null;
            if (!threat && a.digest <= 0) {
              food = this.senseNearest(plantMap, a.x, a.y, a.genes.vision);
            }
            let desired = a.heading;
            if (threat) {
              desired = Math.atan2(a.y - threat.y, a.x - threat.x);
            } else if (food) {
              desired = Math.atan2(food.dy, food.dx);
            } else if (this.rng.chance(0.24)) {
              desired = a.heading + this.rng.bell() * 0.9;
            }

            this.eatPlant(a);

            // A frightened moth spends its movement away from the hunter.
            const steps = this.stepsFor(a, speedScale);
            if (threat) {
              for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
                this.headingStep(a, desired, 0.14);
                // Refresh the escape vector as the geometry changes.
                desired = Math.atan2(a.y - threat.y, a.x - threat.x);
              }
            } else if (food && !this.eatPlant(a)) {
              let remaining = steps;
              while (remaining-- > 0 && !this.eatPlant(a)) {
                const dx = food.x - a.x;
                const dy = food.y - a.y;
                if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) break;
                this.headingStep(a, Math.atan2(dy, dx), 0.2);
              }
              this.eatPlant(a);
            } else {
              for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
                if (this.rng.chance(0.35)) desired += this.rng.bell() * 0.35;
                this.headingStep(a, desired, 0.44);
              }
            }
            if (a.digest <= 0) this.eatPlant(a);
          }
        }

        catchPrey(predator, preyMap, prey) {
          if (!prey || !prey.alive || predator.digest > 0) return false;
          prey.alive = false;
          const idx = prey.y * WORLD.width + prey.x;
          if (idx >= 0 && idx < CELLS && preyMap[idx] === this.prey.indexOf(prey)) preyMap[idx] = -1;
          this.deaths.prey += 1;
          this.generationDeaths.prey += 1;
          const gain = 25 + predator.genes.metabolism * 9;
          predator.energy = Math.min(predator.energy + gain, predator.genes.repro * 1.7 + 30);
          predator.digest = SPECIES.predator.digestTime;
          this.hooks.onEffect?.('kill', prey.x, prey.y, { species: 'prey' });
          this.hooks.onEffect?.('feed', predator.x, predator.y, { strength: gain });
          return true;
        }

        updatePredators() {
            const preyMap = this.createMap(this.prey);
            const speedScale = this.movementModifier();
            const count = this.predators.length;
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
              const hunter = this.predators[i];
              if (!hunter.alive) continue;
              const here = preyMap[hunter.y * WORLD.width + hunter.x];
              if (hunter.digest <= 0 && here >= 0) {
                const prey = this.prey[here];
                if (this.catchPrey(hunter, preyMap, prey)) continue;
              }

              const seen = this.senseNearest(preyMap, hunter.x, hunter.y, hunter.genes.vision);
              let desired = hunter.heading;
              if (seen) desired = Math.atan2(seen.dy, seen.dx);
              else if (this.rng.chance(0.28)) desired = hunter.heading + this.rng.bell() * 0.7;

              const steps = this.stepsFor(hunter, speedScale);
              for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
                if (seen) {
                  const dx = seen.x - hunter.x;
                  const dy = seen.y - hunter.y;
                  if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) break;
                  desired = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                }
                this.headingStep(hunter, desired, 0.24);
                const occupant = preyMap[hunter.y * WORLD.width + hunter.x];
                if (hunter.digest <= 0 && occupant >= 0) {
                  const prey = this.prey[occupant];
                  if (this.catchPrey(hunter, preyMap, prey)) break;
                }
              }
              if (hunter.digest <= 0) {
                const occupant = preyMap[hunter.y * WORLD.width + hunter.x];
                if (occupant >= 0) this.catchPrey(hunter, preyMap, this.prey[occupant]);
              }
            }
        }

        metabolicCost(agent) {
          const g = agent.genes;
          const species = agent.species;
          const base = SPECIES[species].baseCost;
          const cost = base + g.metabolism * 0.083 + g.speed * 0.049 + g.vision * 0.0032;
          return cost * this.metabolicMultiplier();
        }

        updateMetabolismAndAge() {
          for (const species of ['prey', 'predator']) {
            const list = species === 'prey' ? this.prey : this.predators;
            for (const a of list) {
              if (!a.alive) continue;
              a.age += 1;
              if (a.digest > 0) a.digest -= 1;
              a.energy -= this.metabolicCost(a);
              if (a.energy <= 0) {
                a.alive = false;
                this.deaths[species] += 1;
                this.generationDeaths[species] += 1;
                this.hooks.onEffect?.('starve', a.x, a.y, { species });
              } else if (a.age > a.maxAge) {
                a.alive = false;
                this.deaths[species] += 1;
                this.generationDeaths[species] += 1;
                this.hooks.onEffect?.('pass', a.x, a.y, { species });
              }
            }
          }
        }

        reproduce(species) {
          const list = species === 'prey' ? this.prey : this.predators;
          const meta = SPECIES[species];
          const startingLength = list.length;
          for (let i = 0; i < startingLength; i++) {
            const parent = list[i];
            if (!parent.alive) continue;
            if (list.length >= meta.cap) break;
            if (parent.age < meta.minAge) continue;
            if (parent.energy < parent.genes.repro) continue;
            const childGenes = this.makeGenes(species, parent.genes);
            if (GENE_KEYS.some(key => childGenes[key] !== parent.genes[key])) this.mutations += 1;
            const investment = parent.energy * 0.47;
            parent.energy -= investment;
            childGenes._;
            const px = parent.x + this.rng.int(5) - 2;
            const py = parent.y + this.rng.int(5) - 2;
            const child = this.makeCreature(
              species,
              clamp(px, 1, WORLD.width - 2),
              clamp(py, 1, WORLD.height - 2),
              childGenes,
              Math.max(6, investment - 1.4),
              0
            );
            child.origin = 'birth';
            list.push(child);
            this.births[species] += 1;
            this.generationBirths[species] += 1;
            this.hooks.onEffect?.('birth', parent.x, parent.y, { species });
          }
        }

        compactDead() {
          this.prey = this.prey.filter(a => a.alive);
          this.predators = this.predators.filter(a => a.alive);
          this.peak.prey = Math.max(this.peak.prey, this.prey.length);
          this.peak.predator = Math.max(this.peak.predator, this.predators.length);
        }

        applyPlague() {
          const condition = this.activeConditions.get('plague');
          if (!condition) return;
          for (const species of ['prey', 'predator']) {
            const list = species === 'prey' ? this.prey : this.predators;
            const chance = species === 'prey' ? 0.00115 : 0.00042;
            for (const a of list) {
              if (!a.alive) continue;
              if (this.rng.chance(chance)) {
                a.alive = false;
                a.energy = 0;
                this.deaths[species] += 1;
                this.generationDeaths[species] += 1;
                if (species === 'prey') condition.record.toll.prey += 1;
                else condition.record.toll.predator += 1;
                this.hooks.onEffect?.('blight', a.x, a.y, { species });
              }
            }
          }
        }

        fireDueEvents() {
          for (const key of Object.keys(CATASTROPHE_META)) {
            const cal = this.calendar[key];
            if (!cal.enabled) continue;
            if (this.generation >= cal.nextAt) {
              this.triggerCatastrophe(key, cal);
              cal.nextAt = this.generation + cal.interval;
              cal.lastAt = this.generation;
            }
          }
        }

        triggerCatastrophe(key, cal) {
          const meta = CATASTROPHE_META[key];
          const record = {
            id: ++this.eventSerial,
            key,
            label: meta.label,
            glyph: meta.glyph,
            color: meta.color,
            generation: this.generation,
            cycle: this.tick,
            interval: cal.interval,
            toll: { plants: 0, prey: 0, predator: 0 },
            active: true
          };
          const plants = this.plants;
          if (key === 'drought') {
            for (let i = 0; i < CELLS; i++) {
              if (plants[i] > 0.06 && this.rng.chance(0.31)) {
                plants[i] = 0;
                record.toll.plants += 1;
              }
            }
          } else if (key === 'frost') {
            for (let i = 0; i < CELLS; i++) {
              if (plants[i] > 0.05 && this.rng.chance(0.13)) {
                plants[i] = 0;
                record.toll.plants += 1;
              }
            }
          } else if (key === 'plague') {
            // The infection arrives as a condition; its casualties accrue below.
          }
          const duration = Math.round(CYCLES_PER_GENERATION * (key === 'plague' ? 1.85 : 1.45));
          this.activeConditions.set(key, {
            key,
            record,
            startTick: this.tick,
            endTick: this.tick + duration,
            color: meta.color
          });
          this.catastrophes.push(record);
          this.hooks.onCatastrophe?.(record, {
            ...meta,
            interval: cal.interval,
            number: this.eventSerial
          });
        }

        nextScheduledEvent() {
          let best = null;
          for (const key of Object.keys(this.calendar)) {
            const cal = this.calendar[key];
            if (!cal.enabled) continue;
            if (!best || cal.nextAt < best.nextAt) {
              best = { key, at: cal.nextAt, label: CATASTROPHE_META[key].label };
            }
          }
          return best;
        }

        setEventEnabled(key, enabled) {
          const cal = this.calendar[key];
          if (!cal) return;
          cal.enabled = Boolean(enabled);
          if (cal.enabled) {
            cal.nextAt = Math.max(this.generation + cal.interval, this.generation + 1);
          } else {
            cal.nextAt = Infinity;
            this.activeConditions.delete(key);
          }
        }

        setEventInterval(key, interval) {
          const cal = this.calendar[key];
          if (!cal) return;
          cal.interval = clamp(Math.round(interval), 3, 30);
          if (cal.enabled) {
            cal.nextAt = Math.max(this.generation + cal.interval, this.generation + 1);
          }
        }

        setMutation(percent) {
          this.settings.mutation = clamp(Number(percent), 0, 30);
        }

        setRegrowth(multiplier) {
          this.settings.regrowth = clamp(Number(multiplier), 0.2, 2.4);
        }

        setHorizon(generations) {
          this.settings.horizon = clamp(Math.round(generations), 4, 160);
          if (!this.finished && this.generation >= this.settings.horizon) {
            this.finished = true;
            this.hooks.onFinish?.(this.history[this.history.length - 1]);
          }
        }

        summaryStats() {
          let occupied = 0;
          let biomass = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < CELLS; i++) {
            if (this.plants[i] > 0.16) occupied += 1;
            biomass += this.plants[i];
          }
          return {
            occupied,
            cover: occupied / CELLS,
            biomass,
            prey: this.prey.length,
            predator: this.predators.length
          };
        }

        geneSummary(species) {
          const list = species === 'prey' ? this.prey : this.predators;
          if (!list.length) return { n: 0, mean: null, sd: null };
          const mean = {};
          const sd = {};
          for (const key of GENE_KEYS) {
            let sum = 0;
            for (const a of list) sum += a.genes[key];
            const m = sum / list.length;
            let variance = 0;
            for (const a of list) {
              const d = a.genes[key] - m;
              variance += d * d;
            }
            mean[key] = m;
            sd[key] = Math.sqrt(variance / list.length);
          }
          return { n: list.length, mean, sd };
        }

        recordGeneration() {
          const stats = this.summaryStats();
          const preyStats = this.geneSummary('prey');
          const predatorStats = this.geneSummary('predator');
          const eventsThisGeneration = this.catastrophes
            .filter(e => e.generation === this.generation)
            .map(e => ({ id: e.id, key: e.key, label: e.label, glyph: e.glyph, color: e.color }));
          this.history.push({
            generation: this.generation,
            cycle: this.tick,
            plants: stats.occupied,
            plantCover: stats.cover,
            biomass: stats.biomass,
            prey: stats.prey,
            predator: stats.predator,
            births: { ...this.generationBirths },
            deaths: { ...this.generationDeaths },
            mutations: this.mutations,
            preyStats,
            predatorStats,
            events: eventsThisGeneration
          });
          if (!this.extinctions.prey && stats.prey === 0) this.extinctions.prey = this.generation;
          if (!this.extinctions.predator && stats.predator === 0) this.extinctions.predator = this.generation;
          this.generationBirths = { prey: 0, predator: 0 };
          this.generationDeaths = { prey: 0, predator: 0 };
        }
      }

      window.Nocturne = {
        VivariumEngine,
        SeededRandom,
        WORLD,
        CELLS,
        CYCLES_PER_GENERATION,
        GENE_KEYS,
        GENE_INFO,
        SPECIES,
        CATASTROPHE_META,
        DEFAULTS,
        makeSimRandom,
        makeViewRandom,
        normalizeSeed,
        formatSeed,
        deriveSeed,
        clamp
      };
    })();
  </script>

  <script>
    /* ============================================================
       II. THE PICTURE, INSTRUMENTS, AND CLOSING REPORT
       ============================================================ */
  </script>
</body>
</html>

Node sim slow; need collect later, not repeat same call. Let's enhance renderer visual. Before that, fix specific CSS layout and mobile later.

Renderer enhancements:
- Background more detail, texture. Add a "substrate mat" static stipple layer maybe.
- Plants brighter, larger:
  - base currently 5.5, size=.65..~2.0; at cover 14% tiny. Set size = 1.0 + base*(0.14 + b*.32) => 1.8-3.5. Alpha brighter. Better.
  - colors: low `.32`, mid `.52`, bright `.72`. Use larger.
  - But if full cover it's dense enough. At low cover still visible.
  - Add a faint underlayer for depleted soil at all cells? Maybe use all cells faint dark green dot to show culture medium. If cover 7%, world still dark. We can add a static "substrate" of dead mycelium dots visible regardless, e.g. 5000 darkest dots, to make the field alive. It may misrepresent plant population but as substrate/anthropogenic "glass bed" okay. Design wants ecosystem; showing soil texture is valid. Use less bright/dimmer brown/moss at 35% of cells precomputed. This gives organic field. We'll precompute `substrateDots` positions (maybe 2500) and draw them faintly in background. That fills emptiness without implying live moss. Color dark olive, alpha 0.05–0.12. Also maybe faint root/contour line.
  - Draw a static layered radial "culture stains" or contour rings to enrich.
- Moths:
  - Increase glyph size by 1.3: base 5.5 -> wing 4 currently ~7px wide; set wing base*.92=5.3, body. Add fill? Could draw tiny translucent wing shapes, not only strokes:
    ```
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(preyRgb, alpha*.15); ctx.beginPath wings shape fill; then stroke
    ```
    Fine. Use 0.75 line. Make glow smaller to reduce dust bokeh: currently `glow = base*(2.6+readiness*1.1)` =14-20px, 0.33 alpha. Many glows make starry bright dots bigger than glyph. Reduce glow size to 8-14 and alpha .22-.4. That still luminous. Or intentionally they look like fireflies; but user needs distinguish prey glyphs. Make glyphs more visible.
  - The 700 prey in screenshot looked like gold fireflies. 488 at gen16, but many bright blobs. Glow probability. Increase glyph size to 2x and reduce glow.
  - Predators: current ~6.3px size, almost indistinguishable from prey. Increase to base*1.5 = 8.4, brighter rust, thicker line. Use a distinctive four-legged glyph. Glow larger but not too bright.
  - Plant glyphs are small; stars rare. Add occasional larger sprigs (3-prong) to convey flora.
- Background grid currently invisible. Strengthen slightly.
- Add a slow ambient "cloud" gradient moving? Could animate subtle. No need.
- Add center of glass highlight; CSS sheen.

- Color adjustment: Stage at screenshot has a nice atmospheric. Add more jade green texture. Maybe use plants color more yellow-green. At low cover the stage is mostly black; substrate.

Let's implement:
- In reseed build `substrateDots` array with x,y,r,alpha,angle from view RNG (900-1400 dots).
- Draw in drawGraticule? separate `drawSubstrate()` before plants. Method:
```
ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter'; for dots...
fillStyle rgba(105,122,82, .06..)

Event banner looks lovely. Tint not obvious in screenshot because capture 500ms and tint maybe subtle; stage appears blue-green maybe. Condition chip at top right good. The overall composition is nice. But the organism glyphs still look like grains at this scale; yes pale capsule shapes. Need change. The rotation + line wings not reading; perhaps because two curved strokes become like an elliptical pair. We need a glyph that reads clearly even at ~8px. Maybe use a "moth" symbol with larger angular wings and contrast. Or use small chevrons that look like wings clearly: use two short diagonal strokes from a central point plus body dot (like a bird?) Predator uses spider. Plant uses dots. Could draw prey as a "winged seed" with two swept lines and an antenna; maybe the existing looks like a grain because it's effectively an elongated double-ellipse. Better use a distinct angular glyph: draw a small kite/diamond with notches: ``` path: moveTo(0, -w) // forward tip lineTo(w*0.62, -w*0.2) // right wing lineTo(w*0.25, w*0.15) lineTo(0, w*0.55) // tail lineTo(-w*0.25,w*.15) lineTo(-w*.62,-w*.2) close ``` fill barely or stroke. Rotated toward heading. This is a moth silhouette with angular wings. At 10px it looks like a V/butterfly. Use stroke, no fill maybe. Add wing vein line. We want high legibility. Could use fixed unrotated orientation for all? In a naturalist overview, moths exhibit varied orientations. Glyph with symmetric wings may still read as a butterfly even rotated. The current "two curved strokes + body + antenna" is weird due top-down. Let's make the shape: - direction along x axis (heading). Head at +wing*.9, tail at -wing*.9. Wings extend to y ±wing*.75 around x=0. ``` ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-wing*.9, 0); // tail ctx.lineTo(-wing*.2, -wing*.25); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(wing*.2,-wing*.8, wing*.65,-wing*.55); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(wing*.35,-wing*.1, wing*.9,0); // head ctx.quadraticCurveTo(wing*.35,wing*.1, wing*.65,wing*.55); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(wing*.2,wing*.8,-wing*.2,wing*.25); ctx.closePath(); ctx.stroke(); ``` This draws an open moth silhouette with a pointed head. Fill very low alpha. Add antennae. At tiny scale, might read as a bowtie, which is good (moth wings). Add two dots? no. - Or use just two triangular wings and a body line: draw `moveTo(-w,.2w) lineTo(0,-.8w) lineTo(0,.8w)` etc. Hmm. - The current glyph is essentially two curved wings connected at x; may look like a grain because both wings curve similarly and fill none. Wait screenshot after latest patch? Event screenshot was captured after glyph patch? Yes, likely. They still look like grains, perhaps because the rendering at 1x + screenshot downsizing softens. They appear as pale elongated ovals due glow and many lines. - Make glyph larger and higher contrast with dark outline? They're on dark. use fill with 0.2 and stroke ~1px. Reduce glow further. Use a color close to pale gold. - Maybe an abstract `>—<` glyph: draw left and right chevrons around a body. Like `))((`, which reads as wings. Use two V shapes: ``` at forward: left wing starts body and goes to (-0.7w,-0.8w) then back to (0.3w,0); right next... ``` Actually if body along x, wings behind and spread. A pair of acute triangles from thorax. Use filled translucent triangles: - left wing: (0,0) → (-0.9w, -0.75w) → (-0.5w, 0.15w) close (swept back) - right wing: (0,0) → (-0.9w, 0.75w) → (-0.5w,-0.15w)? That's crossing. This creates a swallow/moth shape with wings behind, plus body line and antennae. - fill with rgba(gold,.22), stroke with .9. - At small size, a V-shaped silhouette, recognizable as moth. - Maybe rendering more granularity means 430 creatures too much. Could render only a sample? No, represent all. It's fine. - We can add `ctx.scale`? no. - Predators are more visible now (red cross with ring). In screenshot, they look like small red starbursts. Good. - The event banner card looks great. Condition chip is subtle. The top gradient improved labels. Nice. - At header, status changed to HELD IN GLASS because we set running false. Good. - Tint maybe too subtle; screenshot doesn't show an obvious blue tint. The tint mix-blend-mode soft-light with opacity and radial gradient maybe. We can make stronger / add a thin color wash overlay. Requirement restrained; okay but visible event moment should be discernible. Banner is the main announcement; tint can be subtle. Maybe increase `--tint-color` alpha. - The control panel starts below fold; user scrolls. expected.

  - At max 640 `.eyebrow` font 7px maybe; "FIELD OBSERVATORY · PLATE VII · A CLOSED SUCCESSION". It wraps. Could hide the third part? Use spans with classes. Could CSS hide last? It's text.   - Title 2 lines is dramatic. Fine.
- The main stage headline at top-left now with stronger sub line visible; yes.

- Touch targets for icon buttons are 31px diameter; slightly under 44px recommended. User asked keyboard support, not mobile touch. But quality: increase tap area on mobile with pseudo? We can set button width 36, min 36. The transport row at mobile enough. Could make 38. Minor.

Deterministic yes. Good. Now we need finalize high quality. Remaining major tasks: - Verify charts / UI deep interactions, full reports. - Fix mobile aria-labels. - Fix default report maybe head line. - Add custom tooltips to all controls? done. - Maybe add more accessibility improvements. - Ensure no hidden bug in seed selection because state values at initialization not engine DEFAULTS? yes. - Fix docH at smaller height? acceptable. - Possibly include explicit note that simulation can run headless? Maybe not needed visually. - Add aria live? okay. - Need allow controls live and smooth while report. done. - Need include all required controls. check: seed, mutation, food regrowth, generations, tempo, catastrophe intervals. Yes. - Each control has sparkline. yes. - Small sparkline next to seed? yes. - Multiple catastrophe intervals each. yes. - Need speed gene? no UI. Let's systematically audit requirements and polish. ### Requirement audit 1. **Single-file index.html inline CSS JS, no build, no external libraries/network.** - yes. Data URI internally references SVG namespace URL string, not network. No external ``, no `fetch`. We should perhaps avoid the literal http in SVG namespace as a "network request" audit; it's XML namespace not fetched. Fine. - No source maps etc. 2. **Evolving ecosystem plants, prey, predators on 2D grid.** - yes. Cell grid; plants biomass cells; agents on grid. 3. **Auto-start on page load and run N generations on its own.** - yes with requestAnimationFrame; at end open report. We tested auto report. - one nuance: if the tab is backgrounded, rAF pauses. On foreground it resumes. fine. - simulation run time default at 4x ~? 36s. Good. - "run for N generations" yes configurable horizon; stops at horizon. 4. **Each creature carries gene vector (speed, vision, metabolism, reproduction threshold) or tiny NN mutates on reproduction.** - yes all four, inherited and mutated. Reproduction threshold. - Mutations bounded. - We use gene values in behavior and energy. Good. - We should ensure reproduction threshold mutation affects behavior. yes. - Genes charts. 5. **Seeded PRNG for all randomness; same seed always same run.** - Sim engine deterministic validated. No Math.random. Visual uses separate seeded PRNG. New seed derived deterministically. Live controls change outcomes if changed, expected. - Some non-seeded randomness? The event timers no; `performance.now` not. CSS noise deterministic. Particles visual seeded. `viewRng` seeded. No Math.random. Search done. Need check `crypto` none. Good. - We use `Math.sin`, etc. deterministic. - Same seed and same settings produce same; test identical. - We exposed engine headless. 6. **Logic separate rendering -> headless / faster than real time.** - yes `window.Nocturne.VivariumEngine`, pure; app loops separately. We can add an explanatory comment or tiny UI? Not required. - Headless run via engine.runToEnd. Verified. 7. **Design main deliverable, living specimen under glass, controls part of composition.** - yes. Distinctive naturalist nocturne aesthetic, integrated console. 8. **Pick one distinctive visual direction, deliberate palette, type pairing, one memorable signature.** - Nocturnal field journal / closed vivarium with luminous moss and moths. - Palette paper/ink/moss/gold/rust. - Type pairing Iowan Old Style + SF Mono. - Signature: strong. Could think whether one memorable signature element exists. The stage's luminous specimen plate with moth glyphs and reticle. Maybe strengthen "under glass" by adding a glass bevel and specimen label. Already. - Need maybe mention concept in UI? The title and labels. Good. 9. **Each species colors and glyph language.** - plants pale chartreuse stipple + asterisk; prey gold four-wing silhouettes; predator rust ring/spider glyph. yes. 10. **Every variable integrated control surface; custom sliders, dials, steppers, toggles; live value readouts units ranges.** - yes. Seed & generations are steppers, mutation/regrowth sliders, tempo dial, events toggles with interval steppers. - Sparkline per. yes. - Ranges: sliders have min/max labels only "fixed/volatile"; numeric range represented by full track; aria min/max. Could more explicit values at endpoints? User says sensible ranges, not necessarily labels. We could add endpoints "0% / 30%" instead of fixed/volatile? The conceptual labels are atmospheric but less explicit. Better add numeric range marks perhaps. "fixed / volatile" while aria values numeric. It's okay but a user may not know range; the current value shows. Requirement "units and sensible ranges" means slider min/max should be sensible. We meet. - Event intervals displayed `g`; could maybe use "GEN" full to be clearer. In tight space, `g` is okay; tooltip has detail. But unit clarity matters. Use `12g` (generation). The title of group. Maybe change to `12 gen` with wider. But side width limited 344, grid columns: 24px switch + min70 name + auto stepper + 48 spark. There's room? 19 padding each =>306 content. 24+8 gaps*3=24 + name~100 + stepper 70 + spark45 =263 plus... maybe. "12 gen" min 40. It may fit. We can set `stepper-value` min-width 40 and text "12g". Good. - Tempo range numeric 1-12 not shown; "slow swift" conceptual. Could add `1` and `12` under scale rather than slow/swift. Requirement units and ranges. Use "1×" and "12×" perhaps more precise though less poetic. Could incorporate both: `1× slow` and `12× swift`. Simple. In HTML `.dial-scale slowswift`. Change to `1× slowswift 12×`. Aesthetic okay. - Horizon max 120 not shown; stepper. Fine. - Seed range 0..999999; not shown. Fine. - Catastrophe interval min 3 max 30; not shown; stepper. Fine. - Could enhance tooltips mention ranges. Current tooltips describe effect, not range. Requirement "sensible ranges" not necessarily tooltip. We can add range to tooltips: - mutation data-tip "0–30% per birth" maybe. - regrowth "0.20×–2.40×". - horizon "4–120". - tempo "1–12". - event interval "3–30 generations". - This would be good. Update data-tip texts. - Also label slider endpoint "fixed" and "volatile" could show values `0%` and `30%` small. Maybe keep atmosphere. - Readout values and units clear. 11. **Each control tooltip, keyboard support, visible focus.** - yes, added aria-describedby; native controls; custom dial keyboard. Toggles button. - Range keyboard works. Steppers. Seed input. - Custom tooltip positioning. - Need verify tooltip on seed wrapper is triggered by the number input focus; yes. `data-tip` on control; focusin closest. It is linked. - Each control's sparklines aria-hidden. fine. - `event-switch` parent data-tip. focus gets described. - The custom dial data-tip on parent. Focus receives. - The "toggle" event rows, keyboard toggles. - Focus visible for title? yes. 12. **Live apply smooth feedback.** - Yes. - Changing seed / interval restarts; others live. Catastrophe interval update live. - Change horizon applies. If shortening below current gen, report auto. Good. 13. **Scheduled catastrophe system (drought, plague, third) at configurable intervals.** - yes drought, plague, frost with toggles and intervals per type. - fire at generation boundaries. Good. - Config intervals apply. 14. **Restrained on-theme announcement (tint/banner/timeline).** - banner card; tint; condition chip; timeline markers. Great. - "Mark it on charts." yes population and trait (faint lines). - Timeline marker has tooltips. - Event ledger report. 15. **At run end transition to polished dashboard with population curves and trait-drift charts (mean and spread per gene per species), drawn on canvas in same language.** - yes; auto transition after 1s; charts canvas. - Population chart: plant cover on right, animals left. It doesn't show raw plant counts but percentage; still population curves. Good. - Trait charts show mean & ±1 SD per species (two species). For each species when extinct no data; line stops. good. - Report polished. 16. **Other expected features** - no external; responsive; accessible. - focus states. ### Improvements to make: A. Range units and tooltip ranges. B. Mobile report button labels. C. Mobile specimen heading hide fig-meta; maybe improve. D. Fix event ledger overflow by max-height. E. Fix chart labels font size on mobile. F. Event marker charts stronger. already. G. Fix `aria-hidden` on reports and focus trap maybe. H. Perhaps add hover tooltips on charts; already. I. Add visible hint for keyboard shortcuts? Transport tooltips enough. J. Add "copy link"? no. K. The auto report button icons on mobile need aria-label. L. Update `eventEffectCopy` and no events. M. Chart report generates tooltips on hover; close. N. Maybe keyboard focus on chart tooltip? no. O. Fix potential memory/perf bugs. P. Avoid automated `updateEventMarkers` DOM every generation even if no events? done with onGeneration; could still, but 1/sec fine. Q. Stage generation display might not update graphics when running due HUD every 140ms. fine. R. The "NEXT EVENT / DROUGHT · G12" text in transport-tail is clipped on mobile? It showed fine. S. On 1440 desktop, control `droughtInterval` display 12g; group image. fine. T. The parent openReportButton hidden when report open; after closing shown. Good. U. When report is open, `loop` still schedules rAF but skips drawing; fine. Energy. V. Closing report leaves simulation stopped. Button open report shown. Play disabled. Good. W. The user might click "Inspect final plate" and then see "Chamber closed" and report button. fine. X. "Repeat seed" does not set state.running? startSimulation(true) autoplay. good. Y. Report action icons: top. good. Z. Ensure simulation ends exactly at N and dashboard title. yes. ### Fix report chart fonts / labels Population chart font sizes dynamic: ``` const fontXs = w < 560 ? 8.5 : 7.5; const fontSmall = w < 560 ? 8 : 7; ``` - y labels bigger; axis top labels. - Trait y labels too. - Draw event glyphs 9 on mobile. - The chart's top margin maybe 46 on mobile due labels. Use 46. Actually current top 43. Good. - The chart markers letters y=top-10-lane*9; with multiple at close maybe overlap title labels. Fine. - Trait chart height 130; could set CSS at mobile `height: 150px`; more readable. `@media max-width720 .trait-canvas{height:150px}`. But report content already scroll; fine. - On desktop, trait canvases 130 tall. Could increase to 145 for more clarity. The chart looks dense but good. Maybe 138. Keep. ### Bug in CSS: `.readout .unit` and output "µ 20.0% / birth" etc. screenshot shows. good. ### Catastrophe announcement and event effects - On event, condition chip. Test at full screenshot maybe. Already. - The event banner color `eventInk` for drought etc. fine. - The condition active dot color. - Event markers timeline position. Need test visible. We'll capture bottom strip after first event; likely. - The tint is subtle. The user asked restrained, good. - Timeline marker should mark on progress bar. The code adds. - Need test `updateEventMarkers` after event. In event screenshot, bottom was cut. We'll capture with proper viewport and see; later. ### Seed control input style - At desktop, input is 74 px; the `seed-field` holds minus+input+plus. At screenshot width maybe 148, leaving sparkline to right. Good. The `seedNew` button. Fine. - The `seed` new seed deriving deterministic maybe. - The seed field updates on input `change`; pressing enter. good. - But our test showed after changing seed, focus remained tempoDial (we set focus there and input change programmatically). Real user focusing seed then entering would focus. okay. - If user uses up/down buttons, resets. - `state.seed` not updated when manual invalid typed until change. header uses state seed. fine. ### Engine event schedule bug on toggling enabled: - `setEventEnabled` toggles, if enabled nextAt = generation+interval. Good. - In UI, if turned off, control row dims but interval still adjustable. fine. - When turning back on at current gen, event scheduled after full interval. - Active plague if disabled disappears but record remains active true. Report doesn't show active. okay. - Default event intervals maybe 12,17,9. Good. ### Improve sim dynamics? - Default seeded run survives and charts. Great. The data means there are event distinctions. - At end plant cover 7% sparse; the report stage behind not important. The charts show. - The "closed world" narrative says 288 glasswings and 13 embers remained; correct. - Population chart shows event markers and curves. - Trait charts show speed rise 20%, vision contract. Good. - User can set horizon 4 to finish quickly; report. At min 4 there may be no catastrophes. Fine. - Future user might set intervals to 3 and horizon 4 => event at 3. Scheduled. - The event toggles all on; first frost at 9. The default run 36 includes 9 events. Lovely. ### Potential visual bug report layout at 900: - `docH` of report? 1278; scroll. fine. - The footer is at very bottom but report content is scroll. good. - The report top actions sticky? Not; if user scrolls down, actions offscreen. Fine. - On mobile, report top has unlabeled icons. Fix aria-label and maybe visible labels at mobile? Requirement design. The icons are understandable? Back chevron and circular arrow. Add `title` tooltips? Report buttons don't show custom. Could display labels if width permits; at 390 maybe fit? Top row currently brand text + two buttons; labels hidden at max 720. We can use aria. But visual clarity maybe add small text on buttons even mobile? Buttons would be ~110px each, total 220 + brand 250 > 390. Could hide brand text or stack actions below. Better keep icons with aria/title and maybe use `title` attributes; on desktop labels. It's acceptable. - Add `title` to report buttons? Tooltips not integrated. Could use native title. We can add. - Add `aria-label` "Return to the final specimen plate" and "Repeat this seed". - Report footer New specimen / Inspect final plate labels visible on mobile? Footer actions wrap, yes. ### Additional adjustment: Remove the constant "field 168 × 104" in graticule could be lovely. okay. ### On-theme visual moment for events and signal - Event banner is a physical label with double dotted border. nice. - The stage tint might be too subtle. Could inspect a screenshot with banner + tint after patch; earlier stage looked similar. Maybe increase tint visibility but keep subtle. Set tint gradient from transparent 25% to color at edges with opacity maybe .8; mix-blend soft-light. In screenshot edges show green still. Perhaps use `box-shadow: inset 0 0 80px var(--tint-color)` plus an overlay? CSS `mix-blend-mode: color`? Better add an inset box shadow on `.chamber` class; JS could set custom property. The tint element currently background radial gradient. If `mix-blend-mode: soft-light`, on dark it's subtle. Use `mix-blend-mode: screen` maybe colors edges. But screen of muted colors would brighten edges. We can add another CSS property `filter:saturate(1.1)` no. The banner clearly announces. Requirement says restrained; no need stronger. - The condition chip persists. ### Simulation graphics / rendering edge - The renderer draws plants and creatures after background; stage overlay gradient. - The canvas field is not circular. The graticule adds an engraved lens. Signature element perhaps. ### On page load screenshot, app auto runs and count updates. We should ensure first content not blank while fonts. Canvas starts drawing. In earlier `--virtual-time` screenshot blank because error; fixed. Should ensure draw called before first rAF with no errors. Yes. - Error logs after latest test none. Good. - Need possibly handle negative progress clamp now. yes. ### More careful chart identity - The trait chart y labels should use same unit and darker accent. - Could add a "drift summary" in trait panel: mean shifts small. Not required. - The spread band is one shaded area; yes. ### Improve chart title and data alignment - On mobile report, chart legend wraps. fine. - The report's summary ledger is below chart on mobile; good. ### Rename "What remained alive" for extinct run still fine. ### "observations closed." - Report title static; if both extinct, "The glass closed." works. ### Maybe use "nocturne moss" vs "moss" in narration. Good. ### Check line `chartHoverIndex` value after extinction etc. - On chart hover, mouse over chart but page scrolled; coordinates computed from canvas. okay. - `populateChartTip` uses `canvas.parentElement` = wrap; x, y and rect. good. - Pointerleave might fire when moving into the chart tooltip? Tooltip has pointer-events none. no. - Reports hover draws crosshair and then redraw chart. Great. - Chart pixel visual labels use CSS font; system fallback. - On high DPI. - On resize, chart's chartTip stays? onWindowResize draws charts but if chartHoverIndex not null, chart tip position stale. Minor. Could hide on resize. ### Optimize fonts? - Font pair use native families. okay. - The title uses hanging `Th` ligature? no. - Use `font-variant-ligatures`; default. ### Page accessibility: - The controls maybe inside `
` with aria-label. - `label` for sliders; seed input aria; buttons. - `role=slider` custom dial. Does dial support pointer keyboard and `aria-valuetext` updates. yes. - No visible label for dial scale min/max; readout. fine. - Stepper values are spans with `aria-live` for horizon; event intervals not live but clicking plus likely screen reader won't announce the changed value because focus stays on button. Better: - Add `aria-live="polite"` to all `.event-stepper .stepper-value` spans? Steppers value changes; screen readers will announce. Add `aria-live=polite` via HTML for each id. - Seed field input value already. - Tempo dial role slider announces value. - Mutation range native readout accessible; aria-valuetext updated. - Horizon live. good. - Toggle buttons need `aria-checked` yes. Need trap focus? Could add simple focus trap for Tab in report. Good quality. The events at G9/F, G12/D, G17/P, G18/F, G24/D, G27/F, G34/P, G36/D & F. In screenshot letters at top. Great. - The user can't hover event labels individually but can hover data to see events at that generation. Good. ### Stage event markers on timeline: - The markers are small diamonds. Need inspect. likely. ### Performance and code quality - The engine currently includes `settings.mutation` range clamp 0..30; app uses max30. good. - App's horizon clamp max120 vs engine 160. fine. - Catastrophe interval clamp 3..30. - Food regrowth engine clamp 0.2..2.4, app min 0.2 max 2.4 step .05. - Mutation min 0 max30 step .5. - Tempo min1 max12 step .5. - Seed int 0..999999. - Generations min4 max120. Sensible. - Units: seed "INT", mutation "µ", food growth ×/cycle, N generations, speed × real time, intervals g. Good. ### Better readout for horizon - The label "Generations N", right "BEFORE REPORT"; left stepper, unit "generations". Redundant but okay. - In the mobile screenshot, `generations` appears aligned center after stepper, `BEFORE REPORT` on right top. Fine. ### Mutation label "µ" but display 6.0%; actual mutation rate internal 0.06. unit consistent. ### User asked "small sparkline next to each knob showing its effect" our sparks are mini abstract previews. Good enough. The tempo sparkline is bars, catastrophe sparks event catches. The seed sparkline is a waveform fingerprint. - We should maybe explain sparkline effects in tooltips? Not necessary but could be nice: - "The trace beside each instrument previews its effect; for the seed it is the fingerprint of its random stream." Not included. Could add a tiny microcopy in console foot. Maybe `ALL RANDOMNESS SEEDED · LIVE`. Hmm. - The design has enough. ### Background / ornamental page - The paper grain appears subtle. nice. - The seal icon is delicate. - The top rule with diamond. nice. - The dual layout and side panel. ### Potential title mismatch: "A closed succession" eyebrow; report "FIELD REPORT". Good. ### Event words: - Third "Frost" not "cold snap". Good. - The "weathers" plural in meta. fine. - "Disturbance I/II/III" order displayed. good. - The event record number uses global sequence, not type. fine. ### Jinja? no. ### Outstanding: Need modify after tests: 1. Tooltip ranges. 2. Range numeric endpoints. 3. aria labels for report buttons. 4. trap focus. 5. chart/tip mobile font sizes. 6. trait swatch dashed. 7. event ledger max height 274. 8. maybe responsive specimen heading. 9. event marker chart letters potentially too high; okay. 10. fix event title if hidden due report. 11. stage top legibility. ### Test default seed report at 900 We need capture exactly final default run to evaluate. Use reload, force fast finish, screenshot. We'll do after adjustments. ### Verify no exceptions in console after all actions. done except old. ### Verify external requests via CDP Network events? Could inspect performance resources: `performance.getEntriesByType('resource')` should be empty except document? Data URIs maybe not. We'll check. `fetch` none. ### Verify no `Math.random` (rg returns no results except not). Good. ### Verify no external hrefs. Data URIs. ### Verify syntax. ### Maybe optimize event scheduler to stop duplicates. ### Improve responsiveness of console at 900: - At 900 exactly all fits. Good. - At viewport 768 (inner) body scroll; acceptable. - At 1024 landscape console stacked below (breakpoint 1180) and page scroll. Fine. ### Improve mobile masthead: - The status "UNDER OBSERVATION" wraps; could shorten to "OBSERVING" on small screens with CSS? We can use two spans or JS? At mobile, title area taking two lines already. Could simply reduce status font and remove wrapping `white-space:nowrap`; width. In screenshot "UNDER OBSERVATION" wraps at word because runhead row width; fix by `white-space: nowrap` on `.status` at mobile, and allow meta to compress. It might fit: status about 110px, meta seed+epoch+cycles about 250px = 360 within 366, tight; with gaps would overflow. The current screenshot uses two rows: status left and meta right in one row? Actually at mobile `.runhead` flex-direction row, justify-between. Status is left 2 lines, meta has 3 pairs across. It fit, but "UNDER OBSERVATION" wrap looks awkward. Could shorten via responsive CSS using a span or hide "UNDER"? Use status text dynamic "UNDER OBSERVATION"; on mobile the JS could set "OBSERVING" instead. Simpler CSS `white-space:nowrap`, font 8px, letter-spacing .08em`, giving ~90px. The meta is ~230; total 320 + gap 11 fits 366. Current font 9px .13em yields ~120; still fit? The screenshot shows it wrapped because each item within flex had `min-width` maybe. `.status` flex item can shrink; text can wrap. Set `white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0;`; then meta potentially. At 390 width content 366; run head width auto full; status ~125, meta maybe 230 => 355, gap? justify-between no gap; could fit narrowly. Might. At 360 width could overflow. We can hide cycles at <=400? Use media query. Or allow the meta to wrap. Better design: at mobile, hide `.runmeta div:nth-child(3)` (Cycles) and maybe letter spacing. Then fits. The simulation stage already shows cycles. Do that. Hide cycles at max-width 640; set `.status { white-space: nowrap; }`. Also maybe reduce gap. Then status row clean. - Specimen heading at mobile: hide `.fig-meta`; keep left "FIG I / IN SITU" and center? The `.specimen-heading` has 3 elements: eyebrow, latin hidden, fig-meta. Without fig meta only eyebrow left and justify-between absent. Use `justify-content:space-between` but no right text. Could show "sealed" etc. Maybe label is fine. Hide fig-meta and set display block. The screenshot shows the header's fig-meta wrapped 2 lines; removing cleans. The top-left label "Specimen 007"... already inside. We'll hide `.specimen-heading .fig-meta` at mobile. The left `FIG I / IN SITU` is enough. - The eyebrow at top can be one line with smaller font: at 390 it wraps; perhaps hide last phrase via markup. We can restructure with `` around "A closed succession". At max-width 640 hide `.eyebrow .optional`. The separators around would remain. Use markup: `

Field observatory · Plate VII · A closed succession

` CSS mobile `.optional, .optional-sep {display:none}`. This makes header eyebrow one line. Similarly in report? report eyebrow wraps but fine. Need modify only header. At mobile eyebrow could still wrap "FIELD OBSERVATORY · PLATE VII" ~ 27 chars at 9px tracking = maybe 260px, fits 366. Good. - On mobile action bar top: top-left seal plus title; fine. - The runhead status with shortened "OBSERVING" could be dynamic based on state. Instead apply CSS text? Could add JS `statusText` value "Under observation" but set on mobile via media query not easy. We can hide the lamp? Use `text-transform` but words. We could use `data-short` and CSS pseudo with content replace on mobile, hide actual text. E.g. `.status #statusText {display:none}` on mobile and `.status::after {content:"Observing"}`. But status may be "Held in glass"/"Specimen closed"; a static pseudo would be wrong. Could add a mobile label updated by JS? Not necessary. Keep wrapping? Better set white-space nowrap and hide cycles. "Under observation" 18 chars probably 120px, meta seed/epoch ~170, total 290 + gap; fits. No need pseudo. Do that. - The mobile page title's "The Nocturnal" on first line and "Vivarium" second is elegant. - The top header eyebrow could be one line. - On mobile, `.plate-rule` and stage. fine. - The stage overlay "SPECIMEN 007" etc. The species key in screenshot is partly hidden? It shows full labels. Good. - The tick marks / bottom black band weird but okay. - The transport on mobile uses a two-row layout, with `next event` and tempo. Good. ### Landscape 1024 Could test later. ### Chart content and axis label font sizes Implement dynamic: - In population chart: `const axisFont = w < 500 ? 9 : 8;` Use for left/right and x ticks. Current 7.5/7. Increase at mobile. Keep top captions 7. - Trait charts: dynamic 7.5. - Chart height on mobile maybe 260 already. ### Charts in report scroll - `.event-ledger-list` max height now 274; good. - At 900 desktop the report will show more but not all; okay. - The report "figure" header for trait charts at scroll is shown. - Chart x labels currently "37 gen" while x-axis note. good. - The traits graph's axes labels for reproduction 30, ..., 340. Values. fine. ### On report charts, event markers top might be clipped if lane stacking. If several same gen, lane y above top. There are two at 36; one at -10 and one at -19 = y=24 and 14 within top margin. Good. Three could be 4, fine. Many events at same gen maybe up to 3. At top margin 43. whatever. - drawEventRules uses seen map; for all events including future gen? All ≤ horizon. good. ### Accessibility on chart hover - Chart tip not linked for SR; alt label. fine. - Chart `aria-label` updated in canvas; but role img and label. good. ### Issue: `.chart-legend` uses "Weather" event swatch but event letters. okay. ### Report `event-ledger` order chronological; max height 274 with 6 events all visible. good. ### Need adjust `report-footer .closing-line` text to not go too tiny? fine. ### Source code quality - 5k lines single file, okay. Could reduce maybe. - Comments present. - No `TODO`. ### Testing dynamic seed reset / auto-start - Our test with seed 202 started run and progressed. good. - Toggling drought off and events. good. - Tempo 12. good. - Mutation/regrowth changed. good. - Need confirm simulation settings applied to engine for regrowth; test output state. yes. - "same seed" reproducibility after restart: engine deterministic. UI uses same. - Need verify chart data state no issue with reports after new run. ### Event schedule test and controls - Need test change interval and next event display updates. Not done, but code obvious. Could test. - Need test event banner queue with multiple events same gen. Rare but possible at 36 if horizon; default 36 has drought and frost at 36. At finish, schedule report after 1s; banner display 3.6s, so report opens and hides banner. In report, event markers both. Fine. - Requirement announce each event; if two events at horizon, report opens before second banner. But each event has been recorded. Could be a subtle miss. We could make event processing sequential or avoid same scheduling. Default droughts 12,24,36, frost 9,18,27,36 -> both at 36! The final generation has simultaneous D and F. The banner queue will show the first (D? check order drought, plague, frost; at 36 both drought & frost). Report opens 1s after finish, banner shows maybe only drought for 1s before report. Frost announcement hidden. Both marked in charts and report. Requirement says announce each event. We should handle collision gracefully: - Prevent simultaneous events by if multiple due, trigger one and defer the other to the next generation, or show a combined banner. The simplest simulation-level: only trigger at most one event per generation. For other due types, leave nextAt = current generation + 1 (so next gen). But then schedule intervals shift and may collide again. Or display a combined "DROUGHT & FROST" banner? Requirement each event; can show a banner per event queued, but report opening interrupts. - Better maintain a `pendingEvents` queue in app that displays after report? When report opens, maybe not. - Or avoid scheduling collisions by default intervals (e.g., frost 9, drought 12, plague 17 -> at 36 both drought and frost due since 9*4=36,12*3=36). Could change default frost interval to 10 (at 10,20,30) and drought 12 (12,24,36), plague 17. Then no collision at 36 (frost at 30). But live control can cause collisions. UI user can set intervals same. We can handle programmatically: fire at most one catastrophe per generation, highest priority. The other event reschedule to next generation. This ensures each announced. However the interval for drought at 36 if deferred to 37? horizon 36 ends, never fires. If no collision thanks default new values, fine. Any collisions user-caused maybe. - We can set default frost interval 8? 8,16,24,32; drought 12,24,36; collision 24. Use 9 -> 9,18,27,36 with drought 12,24,36. collision 36 only. Use 11 -> 11,22,33; plague 17,34; drought 12,24,36. No collisions. But frost every 11 is less frequent. First at 11 (after drought 12? first frost 11, drought 12, plague 17). Good. Default frost 11. Then 3 frosts (11,22,33). Total events 3 droughts,2 plagues,3 frosts =8. Fine. The UI copy says default 9. Change to 11. Does this change ecology & report data? yes, fewer frosts early. The default seed 101 end counts might change, likely survive. Need test. - Even so users can set same intervals causing collisions. We should handle robustly: Sim fires all due but app could queue banners; report opens after 1s. If multiple events at final, second announcement lost. That's not critical if charts/log mark both. "Announce each event" ideally. Could schedule report after banner queue drains? That might delay report by >8s. Alternative combined event banner for simultaneous. Better: * Change engine fireDueEvents to fire only one per generation, prioritizing cool. For the remaining due events, schedule at the next generation(s). This ensures each gets a distinct announcement even if it may exceed horizon. At final horizon, only one event. But some intervals postponed; okay. * However if multiple catastrophic effects desired, not required. This is more refined presentation. * Implementation: ``` fireDueEvents() { const due = keys filter... if(due.length) { const key=due[0]; trigger... nextAt = gen+interval; for other due: cal.nextAt = gen+1; // postpone one gen } } ``` - Could create repeated due each gen after. Fine. - All event types at most one per gen. Markers spaced. - But events would be slightly delayed from configured cadence under collisions. Acceptable. - Default collision at 36 then frost postponed to 37 beyond horizon, only drought fires. Fewer events. Yet chart would show no frost at 36. Better default interval changes avoid collisions. - The task wants events at configurable intervals; postponing edits that slightly. But display order is nicer. - Alternatively trigger all but queue banners in the report's event ledger; that's okay. "each event announced" could be satisfied by banner while run + ledger. I'd prefer not alter simulation complexity. The default collision at final might reduce impact of frost; still effect. Hmm. - We can set default intervals to avoid collisions: drought 12, plague 17, frost 11. Then at 36: drought only (frost at 33, plague 34), so no double. This still leaves user collisions, but default experience good. I'd do this. It also affects ecology (frost 11 instead of 9). Need test default seed 101 final & charts. Likely fine. We'll test with engine. - The text and data says 9 events maybe then 8. Fine. - The third event order says Disturbance III. okay. - The controls default frost 11g and data-tip. Update HTML and engine DEFAULTS. - User expected catastrophe interval singular; no issue. Let's test seed 101 with frost 11 vs 9. We can pass events options. Also maybe other seed. Use Node with one run, may take 20s. We'll do in background later. We already know default 101 with 9 survives. 11 likely too. We can test after other patches. ### Default catastrophe copying "frost third weather" No. ### Should catastrophe effects be more pronounced? - Frost duration 1.45 gen slows and costs. Fine. - Plague direct mortality p=0.00115 per tick over ~333 ticks => 32% prey. Strong. - Drought removes 31% plants and regrowth .25. Strong. - Third frost. ### Could show catastrophe counts / next event in controls group. Not required; top next event. Maybe add status marker within chart? done. ### Additional content in report: - "What remained alive" panel has all needed. - Gene summary units not shown in y axis? headings. - The report's "final count" includes extinctions? meta ledger foot but no direct "extinct generations". Narrative mentions. Good. - Could add extinction gen to meta? not necessary. ### Headless accessibility and reduced motion - prefers-reduced-motion: animations off but simulation still runs. The banner holds 1.8s; report after .3s. Good. Renderer still animated moths/dust? `reducedMotion` sets dust time t=0 but agents still bob if t=0 fixed; plants no animation. Sim runs and entities jump. okay. Could make transport auto-running even reduce; yes. - The auto report opens after 300 ms. Good. ### Potential bug: In reduced motion, `finishTimer` 300ms and `window.setTimeout` in loop no issues. ### Focus trap implementation Add to handleGlobalKeys: ``` if (state.reportOpen && event.key === 'Tab') { const focusables = [...report.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]), [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([-1])')].filter(visible) if ... trap } ``` - The report title has tabindex -1 and is focus target; exclude. - The top buttons + footer buttons. If user Shift+Tab from reportTitle? Focus title then Tab should go to first button since document focus order starts maybe. We can trap if activeElement is reportTitle and shift tab -> last; regular Tab goes next in DOM after h1 (inside report) to chart? not focusable; then footer buttons. Fine. - Implement generic: ``` if Tab: first=focusables[0], last=... if e.shiftKey && (active===first || active===reportTitle) {last.focus; prevent} else if !shift && active===last {first.focus; prevent} ``` - If focus somehow app behind (inert prevents) okay. - Add aria labels for mobile menu. - closeReport focuses openReportButton; it is visible. If report auto-opened while sim finished, yes visible set after close. Use requestAnimationFrame to focus maybe after class hide. direct. - On open, if `document.activeElement` outside? title. - On close when rerun button pressed, closeReport(false) not trap. - add `title` attrs for icons? Maybe. ### Tooltip range text and report buttons Let's patch these quality items: - Change default frost interval 9→11 in DEFAULTS, HTML value/text IDs, data tips? - But the current UI lab state? new page. - Add data-tip range values. - Add numeric dial scale. - Report button aria labels/titles. - Focus trap. - Trait swatch dashed classes. - Responsive header. - Dynamic chart font. Let's do this in patches.
